subject: Request: Short sandbox supplement while PO undergoes audit
messages:
From: Alice Lee <alice@acceleranthealth.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Sep 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Short sandbox supplement while PO undergoes audit

Hi Naomi —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We made great progress and our engineers are running a final integration test this afternoon. Unfortunately procurement started an internal audit of our vendor intake and has flagged the Redwood PO for extra review; legal and finance are looped in. We were told this could take 5–10 business days.

We need to keep the sandbox live for that window so our CX/engineering teams can finish the end-to-end validation. Can Redwood provide a short supplement (tokens or equivalent) or extend the trial by ~7 days while procurement closes out? We won’t change the scope of the evaluation — just need enough runway to finish automated smoke tests and a couple of model comparisons.

If helpful, I can share the audit intake reference number and the point of contact on our side. Appreciate anything you can do — we really want to move to PO as soon as paperwork clears.

Best,
Alice
Alice Lee
Director, ML Integrations
Accelerant Health

Attachments: Accelerant_PO_audit_notes.txt (text/plain)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alice Lee <alice@acceleranthealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, david_kim@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Sep 2028 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Short sandbox supplement while PO undergoes audit

Alice —

Thanks for the heads up and for the clear context. Happy to help so your evaluation doesn't stall. We can provision a short supplement while procurement completes the audit. I can offer a 72-hour token top-up immediately and a 7-day trial extension if you can confirm the audit reference number and the PO contact for our records.

To make this official I’m attaching our bridge-credit terms — nothing commercial changes, it’s a temporary runway accommodation tied to the PO audit window. If that’s acceptable I’ll route the approval through Finance and copy Legal.

Next steps:
- Reply with the audit reference or procurement POC (needed for internal compliance)
- I’ll attach the supplement in your account and confirm once granted

I’ve cc’d Ben and David to flag for quick approval on the backend.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: bridge-credit-terms.pdf (application/pdf)

Subject: Fwd: Re: Request: Short sandbox supplement while PO undergoes audit

Naomi / David —

I’m fine to greenlight the 72-hour tokens (up to $500 equivalent) without a formal PO if Naomi confirms the audit ref in writing. Longer extension (7 days) I’d prefer Finance logs it as a one-time courtesy tied to deal AC-2028-14 so we can track any precedence.

If David signs off on the one-time record, I’ll mark the credit and we can provision immediately.

Ben
